prompts.title: 3D Snapchat Creator
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-quality, Pixar-style 3D animated illustration of a young woman with a warm, friendly, and engaging personality.
Subject & Identity

The character represents a modern female creator. She has expressive eyes, soft natural facial features, and a pleasant, confident smile. Her hairstyle should be natural, slightly voluminous, and well-groomed (adaptable to different looks).
Pose & Action

She is sitting comfortably in a relaxed cross-legged position on top of a minimal white cube slightly right side. A sleek laptop rests on her lap, and she is actively using it, looking to viewers, creating a natural “in-action” moment.
Outfit & Styling

She wears a cozy, modern outfit (e.g., Yellow knitted sweater, casual top, or minimal chic clothing) with soft textures. Add subtle accessories like a delicate necklace or small earrings for personality.
Primary Object

The white cube beneath her features a bold, yellow Snapchat-style logo on its front face.
Background
Seamless white studio backdrop. Floor blends perfectly with the backdrop, creating an infinite studio void.
Background Element (Important)

Behind her, a large modern smartphone stands vertically in left side.

The screen displays a Snapchat-style social media profile UI with:
Profile image
Yellow background image with avatar
Profile name (Prompt Plum)
My stories details
Friends details

Clean Snapchat UI layout

Environment & Lighting

Minimal, clean studio environment with soft neutral tones.

Use soft, diffused lighting with gentle shadows to create a premium, polished look.
Style & Quality

Pixar / DreamWorks inspired 3D character style
Ultra-clean rendering, smooth materials
Soft realistic textures (fabric, hair, skin)
High detail, cinematic depth of field
Balanced, modern composition
Framing

Vertical composition (4:5), subject centered with clear focus, smartphone slightly behind for depth.

prompts.title: Immersive Setup
prompts.prompt:
Transform the uploaded photo into an ultra-realistic, hyper-detailed cinematic photograph with DSLR quality, rendered in 32K resolution, with a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio.
🔒 Identity & Face Preservation (Very Important)
The subject’s face must remain 100% identical to the reference image.
Strictly preserve:

Facial structure
Bone geometry & proportions
Skin tone & natural texture
Eye shape, nose, jawline
Hairline, beard pattern (if present)
Expression & overall identity
No beautification, reshaping, stylization, smoothing, or identity drift.
👤 Subject
A handsome young man fully immersed in a gaming session.

His expression is focused, calm, and intense, with natural skin texture, visible pores, and realistic facial detail.

He is seated upright, typing on a keyboard and looking directly at the glowing screen.
💡 Lighting
Primary light: the gaming monitor in front of him, casting a cool blue glow on his face and glasses
Secondary light: a warm desk lamp from the side, creating soft rim light and depth
Cinematic contrast with realistic shadows and subtle highlights
👕 Wardrobe & Accessories
Black hoodie with “PROMPT PLUM” printed clearly on the chest
Luxury metal wristwatch
Modern blue-light glasses with subtle screen reflections
🖥 Environment
A dimly lit, premium gaming workspace:

Large gaming monitor in front
Gaming chair
Posters of popular video games on the wall behind him
A cup of hot coffee on the desk with visible steam
Headphones resting on the table
The mood should feel immersive, modern, and cinematic.
🎬 Final Style
Hyper-realistic textures (skin, fabric, glass, metal)
Cinematic depth of field
Editorial photography look
Clean high contrast
Natural lighting transitions
Sharp focus with soft background blur
Fully respect the original face and identity while transforming the scene into a cinematic, ultra-realistic gaming portrait.
prompts.description: Generate high-quality AI images of a young man with glasses at a gaming setup using this detailed prompt. Perfect for creating realistic shots of a developer or gamer in a black hoodie with cinematic LED lighting and a mechanical keyboard.
